screen_rectangle.measurement: Four decoded driver-facing surface vertices after original node transform, excluding bezel and screen-box thickness.
screen_rectangle.units: Model coordinates normalized to complete wheel width 1; origin at shaft reference; +Z toward driver.

geometry_adjustments.description: Separate the front GSI logo from the casing to prevent depth flicker.

led_mapping.icon_color: Uniform arithmetic mean of the associated four linear LED colors, using ring gain.
led_mapping.icon_coverage: Authored white grayscale ink in existing opaque sticker RGB; black background retains body shading and atlas alpha is unchanged.

approximations: PBR metallic/roughness, normal maps and clearcoat are not included in AGMESH1; tagged diffusers support live LED emission.
Pure-black diffuse colors receive a 1% linear floor for native simple lighting.
The stock display is replaced with opaque dark pixels for a separate live dashboard.
Default canvas stickers are baked with the original Poppins font and source icons.

optimization.policy: Per-material body simplification with normal/UV error, original vertex positions only; controls, stickers, LEDs, screen, logo, and small parts protected. Full-attribute deduplication and cache/fetch reorder for every part. Atlas unchanged.
